deadline.value: January 15 for international applicants for Fall 2027 (Canadians: June 21); a confirmed supervisor is due by a second, later deadline.
deadline.quote: Application Deadline - International | FALL September 15 January 15 June 21

supervisor.value: You need written support from a supervisor; you may apply first, but must name your supervisor by the second deadline.
supervisor.quote: Confirmation of IPN supervisor | Written support from your supervisor

also.quote: Note that you must inform our admissions office as to who your supervisor will be by the second application deadline.

entry_route.value: Master's or bachelor's holders can apply; direct entry from a bachelor's needs a 3.80 CGPA, research experience and publications.
entry_route.quote: Applicants holding either a graduate degree (Master's) or an undergraduate degree (Bachelor's) from a recognized institution are eligible to apply to our Ph.D. program. | The IPN requires a 3.80 cumulative Grade Point Average (cGPA) out of 4.0 for direct entry into Ph.D.1.
